subject: pe
title: Sport and Equity
welcome_lead: Gender, race, disability, age, class — five lenses on participation.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on equity barriers and policy responses.
final_note: Equity policies must address access, opportunity and representation simultaneously.

concepts.def: Allocation of resources based on need.
Difference in median pay between men and women; large in elite sport.
1972 US law banning sex discrimination in federally funded education and sport.
Elite sport for athletes with disabilities; quadrennial since 1960 Rome.
Historical segregation (e.g., MLB before 1947) and ongoing under-representation in coaching.
Youth and masters competitions; lifelong participation policy goals.

walkthroughs.body_html: Each axis interacts (intersectionality). Black women face combined gender and race barriers.
Title IX equalised US college funding. UK Sport's no compromise policy concentrated funding on medal prospects.
Few minority head coaches in football's top divisions; Rooney rule sought to change this in NFL.
